title: Trust the Lord With All Your Heart
story:
A young boy was visiting a large city with his father for the first time.

There were many roads, tall buildings, and unfamiliar places all around him.

When they came to a busy intersection, the boy became confused and did not know which way to go.

His father held his hand and said, "Stay with me. I know the way."

The boy did not understand why they needed to take a particular road, but he trusted his father and followed him.

After walking for a while, they reached the place they were looking for.

The boy realized that he did not need to understand every turn because his father already knew the way.

Our journey through life can sometimes feel like walking through an unfamiliar city.

There are decisions about our career, family, relationships, finances, and future that we may not know how to handle.

We often want to understand everything before we trust God.

But Proverbs teaches us to trust the Lord with all our heart and not depend only on our own understanding.

When we acknowledge God in everything we do, He promises to guide our paths.

This does not mean that we will always receive an immediate answer or know exactly what will happen next.

It means that we choose to place our confidence in God's wisdom rather than our limited understanding.

Sometimes God may lead us in a direction we did not expect.

When that happens, we can still trust Him because He sees the whole path while we can see only the next step.

Today, whatever decision or uncertainty you are facing, bring it to God.

Trust Him with your whole heart, seek His guidance, and allow Him to direct your path.
life_lesson: You do not need to understand everything before trusting God. Depend on His wisdom, acknowledge Him in every area of your life, and allow Him to guide your path.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being my guide and for knowing the path ahead of me.

Help me to trust You with all my heart instead of depending only on my own understanding.

When I face difficult decisions, give me wisdom to seek Your will.

Help me acknowledge You in every area of my life, including my family, work, relationships, and future.

When Your direction is different from what I expected, give me faith to follow You.

Keep me from relying on my own plans when I should be seeking Your guidance.

Lead my steps and make my path clear according to Your will.

Thank You for being faithful and for guiding me even when I cannot see what lies ahead.

I place my plans and my future into Your hands today.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What decision or area of your life are you finding difficult to surrender to God's guidance?

Are you depending more on your own understanding than on God's wisdom?

What can you do today to acknowledge God and trust Him with your next step?
verse: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.
